rubric: A registry time-out that reads like a timing flake.

criteria.class: the runner, a registry, the network, a quota or a service the job needs failed; nothing in the change can fix it

reading.why: Every request to the package registry timed out during install, before any test ran: the registry failed, which nothing in the change can fix; it looks like a time-out but it is infrastructure.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: real
ruledOut.why: A registry failed during install. It is not: the change broke a test, a build or a lint rule; a fix in the code is needed.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: flake
ruledOut.why: A registry failed during install. It is not: a flaky or timing-dependent failure, likely to pass on a re-run.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: drift
ruledOut.why: A registry failed during install. It is not: the base branch moved: a conflict, a stale lockfile or a base commit the change no longer fits.
